lang.description: Language of messages: en (default) or fa (Persian).

css/physical-property.description: Physical left/right properties do not mirror in RTL; use logical properties. Default: warn.

css/physical-value.description: text-align, float and clear with left/right do not mirror in RTL; use start/end. Default: warn.

css/asymmetric-shorthand.description: A margin/padding/inset/border/radius shorthand with different left and right values will not mirror in RTL. Default: warn.

css/directional-value.description: Opt-in: horizontal translate, background-position and transform-origin values point one way on screen and usually need an RTL counterpart. Default: off.

class/physical-utility.description: Tailwind/UnoCSS/Bootstrap utilities such as ml-4, pr-2, left-0, text-left, border-l and rounded-r do not mirror in RTL. Default: warn.

class/directional-utility.description: translate-x and left/right transform origins (and, with { gradients: true }, horizontal gradients) need an rtl: counterpart to mirror. Default: warn.

jsx/physical-style.description: Inline style objects (React, React Native, Solid, Preact, Vue :style) using marginLeft, paddingRight, textAlign: "left"… do not mirror in RTL. Default: warn.

html/dir-attribute.description: <html> with an RTL lang needs dir="rtl"; a dynamic lang needs a dynamic dir. Default: error.

html/ltr-input.description: Email, URL and phone inputs inherit dir="rtl" and scramble their punctuation; give them dir="ltr". Default: warn.

icon/directional.description: Left/right chevrons and arrows (back/next) keep pointing the same way in RTL; mirror them. Default: warn.

fa/arabic-letters.description: Arabic yeh (ي), kaf (ك) and alef maksura (ى) in Persian text break search, sorting and rendering; use ی and ک. Default: error.

fa/arabic-digits.description: Arabic-Indic digits (٤٥٦) in Persian text; use Persian digits (۴۵۶). Default: warn.

fa/mixed-digits.description: A number written with a mix of Latin and Persian/Arabic digits (e.g. ۱۲3). Default: warn.

fa/zwnj-prefix.description: The verb prefixes می/نمی are joined to the verb with a zero-width non-joiner (نیم‌فاصله), not a space: «می‌روم». Default: warn.

fa/zwnj-joined.description: The verb prefixes می/نمی written glued to the verb («میخواهم») need a zero-width non-joiner: «می‌خواهم». Only known verb forms are touched. Default: warn.

comparatives.description: true (default): ترین always, تر after common adjectives; "all": تر after any word; false: neither.

fa/zwnj-suffix.description: Suffixes such as ها/های/تر/ترین, and ای/ام/اند or the ezafe ی after a final ه, attach with a zero-width non-joiner, not a space: «کتاب‌ها», «خانه‌ی من». Default: warn.

fa/zwnj-invalid.description: Zero-width non-joiners that are doubled, next to a space or outside a word, and ZWJ/ZWSP used where a ZWNJ was meant. Default: warn.

fa/punctuation.description: Latin comma, semicolon and question mark between Persian words; use ، ؛ ؟ Default: warn.

fa/punctuation-spacing.description: No space before ، ؛ ؟ ! . and none just inside « » guillemets. Default: warn.

fa/kashida.description: Kashida/tatweel (ـ) stretches words visually but breaks search and copy; use CSS text-align: justify instead. Default: warn.

code.description: Also check JS/TS and other code files.

text/presentation-forms.description: Arabic-script presentation forms (pre-shaped glyphs from PDFs and old software) look right but break search and screen readers; use the normal letters. Default: error.

security/bidi-control.description: Invisible bidirectional control characters that can hide code (Trojan Source, CVE-2021-42574) or leak direction across a line. Default: error.
